description: Permissions for the main Void window only. The updater and tray-menu windows have their own minimal sets (updater.json / tray-menu.json): a script in those small windows must not reach the clipboard, shortcuts, notifications or autostart. External links open via the custom open_external command (Rust-side opener plugin, http(s) only). Chat attachments are saved by the custom save_file command (dialog + write in Rust) — the webview has NO fs/dialog permissions on purpose. Custom commands are not covered by capabilities, so each sensitive command checks the calling window's label itself (lib.rs, from_main).
